Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 161, "amount_cents": 6723}, {"order_id": 163, "amount_cents": 12727}]
Refunds requested in this batch (from the batch order, signed by Alpha): [{"order_id": 161, "amount_cents": 6723}, {"order_id": 163, "amount_cents": 12727}, {"order_id": 164, "amount_cents": 3509}]
The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Refund for order 164 (3509 cents) was requested in the batch, signed by Alpha, but is not in the refunds table. list_refunds shows only order 161 (6723) and order 163 (12727). W2 reported the refunds as applied, but 164 was not. Payouts are paused until 164 is applied or the request is withdrawn.

reply.thought: The handoff lists three requested refunds but only two reported as applied; order 164 (3509 cents) may be missing. I need to check the refunds table before deciding whether to pay or hold.

The batch requested a refund for order 164 (3509 cents), but the refunds table only has orders 161 and 163. The task says to hold when a requested refund is missing, so I'm stopping the batch before any payouts are recorded.
